rights_basis: Faithful bounded reading transcription of original-language liturgical text from Gregorian Hadrianum (Wilson 1915): complete strict Canon Missae constituent, whose United States copyright term has expired by publication date (1915 critical edition (mediating ninth-century Hadrianum witnesses R, C, O)). Derived directly from tracked public-domain facsimile artifact.catholic-church.sacramentarium-gregorianum-hadrianum.wilson-1915.ia-pdf-96fd93c7 without modern translation or editorial reconstruction. Third-party historical text is excluded from Triptych's CC BY 4.0 license.
text: Hanc igitur oblationem seruitutis nostrae sed et cunctae familiae tuae quaesumus domine ut placatus accipias. diesque nostros in tua pace disponas. atque ab aeterna damnatione nos eripi. et in electorum tuorum iubeas grege numerari. per christum dominum nostrum.
